ev.q: Approximately one in five mothers overall, and approximately 30% of Black, Hispanic, and multiracial mothers reported mistreatment
Approximately one in five (20.4%) respondents reported experiencing at least one type of mistreatment
Overall, 28.9% of respondents reported experiencing at least one form of discrimination during maternity care
Black, Hispanic, and multiracial respondents reported the highest prevalences of mistreatment (30.0%, 29.3%, and 27.3%, respectively).
CDC analyzed data from the PN View Moms survey, an opt-in consumer audience panel survey of U.S. mothers

methods_quotes.q: Descriptive statistics were calculated using Stata software (version 17.0; StataCorp)
No inferential statistical analyses were performed.
Satisfaction with care and mistreatment experiences were summarized overall and stratified by race and ethnicity and health insurance at time of delivery.
Percentages were calculated using the overall number of persons who reported a reason
